*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Vision-guided RoboCasa365 CloseStandMixerHead attempt.
+
+Uses only the robot client, RGB/depth observations, camera calibration, and
+the arm's reported end-effector position.  The side-view seed pixel is a
+manual image-space selection on the raised red head for this frozen scene.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+SIDE = "robot0_agentview_right"
+WRIST = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
+
+
+def pixel_world(obs, camera: str, u: int, v: int, radius: int = 2) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Back-project a valid depth pixel using the response's OpenGL calibration."""
+    dep = np.asarray(obs.depth[camera][0], dtype=float)
+    y0, y1 = max(0, v - radius), min(dep.shape[0], v + radius + 1)
+    x0, x1 = max(0, u - radius), min(dep.shape[1], u + radius + 1)
+    patch = dep[y0:y1, x0:x1]
+    good = patch[(patch > 0) & np.isfinite(patch)]
+    if not len(good):
+        raise ValueError("selected image region has no usable depth")
+    d = float(np.median(good))
+    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    p_cam = np.array([(u - K[0, 2]) * d / K[0, 0],
+                      -(v - K[1, 2]) * d / K[1, 1], -d, 1.0])
+    return (T @ p_cam)[:3]
+
+
+def send_joint(robot: Robot, q: np.ndarray, *, grip: float = -1.0,
+               torso: float = 0.0, steps: int = 10, note: str = ""):
+    a = np.zeros((steps, 13), dtype=np.float64)
+    a[:, :7] = q
+    a[:, 7] = grip
+    a[:, 11] = torso
+    a[:, 12] = -1.0  # arm mode
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[SIDE, WRIST],
+                        video="none", include_depth=True, note=note)
+
+
+def get_pose(robot: Robot):
+    o = robot.get_obs(cameras=[SIDE, WRIST], video="none")
+    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return o, p[4:11].copy(), p[26:29].copy()
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    # Initial right-view seed on the upper edge of the upright head.  Recheck
+    # the RGB patch before contact; use the live depth/calibration, never an
+    # object pose or simulator state.
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[SIDE, WRIST], include_depth=True, video="none")
+    rgb = obs.last[SIDE]
+    if not (rgb[78, 184, 0] > rgb[78, 184, 1] * 1.35):
+        raise RuntimeError("head seed pixel is not red in the current side view")
+    head_top = pixel_world(obs, SIDE, 184, 78)
+    hover = head_top + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.06])
+
+    # The transcripted run used small arm-space adjustments with the torso
+    # lift for vertical approach, pausing for a new camera observation at each
+    # stage.  This conservative routine leaves the gripper open for a push.
+    _, q, xyz = get_pose(robot)
+    J = np.array([[.0064, .2436, .0037, -.0137, .0031, .1767],
+                  [.2525, -.0009, .3419, -.0177, .2074, -.0126],
+                  [0.0, -.2543, .0039, .4745, .0169, .1324]])
+    for _ in range(5):
+        _, q, xyz = get_pose(robot)
+        error = hover - xyz
+        if np.linalg.norm(error) < .025:
+            break
+        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + .05**2 * np.eye(3), error)
+        dq = np.clip(dq, -.08, .08)
+        q[:6] += dq
+        send_joint(robot, q, grip=-1.0, steps=12,
+                   note="small vision-guided mixer-head approach")
+    # Lower in short bursts and inspect each returned image for head rotation.
+    for _ in range(4):
+        _, q, _ = get_pose(robot)
+        res = send_joint(robot, q, grip=-1.0, torso=-.25, steps=4,
+                         note="controlled mixer-head contact/push")
+        if res.done:
+            return
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
